oly which is keeifiiig tbia country down

Take tho items of freight, express,

ing constantly under our notice
since shipments began from Medora to

Almost exactly the same points can be

The passenger rates are also unreason
ably high. Five, six, seven, eight, and

istence or profit :of the road, -we will

ably is possible to buy a ticket from
New York city to Portland, Oregon,
cheaper than one from St. Paul to Mis
soula.

While we are about it, an illustration

one-fourth more in going twice the dis
tance, and has to be repeated twice. ,Oh,
consistency, thr name is not a railroad
or.a telegraph monopoly.
